faqs.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know about working together, timelines, and technical standards.

items.question: What kind of projects are the best fit for your expertise?
items.answer: I specialize in modern single-page SaaS applications, interactive analytics dashboards, high-conversion marketing engines, and distributed cloud backends. If you need a product that demands both pixel-perfect UI and rock-solid architecture, that is my sweet spot.

items.question: Are you available for full-time employment or contract only?
items.answer: I am currently accepting contract projects, technical advisory retainers, and fractional CTO/Lead roles. For extraordinary long-term opportunities with high autonomy, I am always open to conversation.

items.question: How do you handle project payments and milestones?
items.answer: Typically, contracts are split into milestone payments (e.g. 33% upfront on kickoff, 33% upon interactive staging delivery, and 34% upon final production deployment and code transfer). All terms are agreed in an escrow or standard Master Services Agreement (MSA).

items.question: Why do you recommend React/Next.js and Tailwind CSS?
items.answer: Next.js provides the best-in-class blend of server-side performance, SEO optimization, and instant dynamic user experiences. Combined with Tailwind CSS, it enables cohesive design systems with zero CSS runtime bloat and rapid iteration speed.

items.question: Will I own 100% of the code and intellectual property?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely. Once final invoice payment is settled, 100% of all code repositories, design files, credentials, and documentation are transferred to your ownership with zero proprietary lock-in.

items.question: What does post-launch support look like?
items.answer: All project deliverables include a complimentary 30-day (Starter) or 60-day (Pro) bug warranty to ensure everything performs flawlessly in the wild. Extended maintenance retainers are also available.
